Academic Résumé

Mohammad Movahedi, EIT

Ph.D. Candidate in Civil Engineering
FAMU-FSU College of Engineering, Florida State University

Construction and infrastructure management researcher working at the intersection of AI, digital twins, sustainable built environments, disaster resilience, and intelligent transportation.

Email Google Scholar LinkedIn GitHub ResearchGate
3💼 professional roles
12+📜 published works
10🏗️ major projects
11🏆 awards

Profile

  • Ph.D. candidate specializing in AI-driven construction and infrastructure management, digital twins, and sustainable built environments.
  • Published research in venues including IEEE Transactions on Intelligent Transportation Systems and the ASCE Journal of Management in Engineering.
  • Grant-writing experience across NSF, U.S. DOT, private-sector, and university opportunities, including contributions to an awarded NSF CAREER project.
  • Teaching and mentorship experience as a teaching assistant, guest lecturer, and mentor to undergraduate and NSF REU researchers.
